teachers.name: Hala Kurdi
teachers.biography:
Hala Kurdi is a Quran teacher with 12 years of teaching experience.
She teaches Tajweed, Quran memorization (Hifz), and children in English and Arabic.
She welcomes female students of all ages and boys aged 10 and under.
She prefers evening lessons, four days a week.

teachers.name: Ahmed Ayman
teachers.biography:
Ahmed Ayman Elshazly is a Quran teacher with 5 years of teaching experience.
Ahmed teaches Arabic-speaking students Quran recitation, Tajweed, and memorization (Hifz), including children.
Teaching preferences include male students, as well as boys and girls.
Preferred availability is during the day and evening on Fridays and Saturdays, and in the evenings on other days. The schedule is flexible; exact class times will be published separately.

teachers.name: Mariam Al-Khatib
teachers.biography:
Quran & Tajweed Teacher
Mariam Al-Khatib is based in Germany and has 5 years of teaching experience.
Specialties include Tajweed, Quran memorization, and fluent Quran reading.

teachers.name: Youssef Benali
teachers.biography:
Senior Quran & Tajweed Teacher
Youssef Benali es un profesor senior del Corán con 21 años de experiencia en la enseñanza. Reside en España y enseña principalmente en español.
Está especializado en Tajwid, recitación correcta del Corán, lectura fluida, memorización y corrección de la pronunciación y de los errores más comunes en la recitación. Su método de enseñanza es claro, paciente y adaptado al nivel y al ritmo de cada estudiante, desde principiantes hasta alumnos que desean perfeccionar su recitación.
